skill.name: Docusaurus Advanced
skill.description: Explain and configure Docusaurus settings, plugins, custom fields, themes, and MDX.
skill.summary: Guidance for configuring advanced Docusaurus documentation sites.
skill.author: AbdulSamad94

security_audit.summary: All fourteen static detections are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and a documented Docusaurus configuration example. The skill contains no executable commands, network requests, environment-file access, prompt injection, or data-exfiltration intent.

remediation.issue: Client-exposed API configuration can be misunderstood as a secret channel.
remediation.suggestion: Document that customFields are public and must contain only non-sensitive API endpoints.

- **Custom CSS**: `textbook/src/css/custom.css` (contains specific overrides for dark mode and premi
- **Layout**: `Layout` wrapper is often used in `src/pages` for standalone React pages within Docusa

content.value_statement: Docusaurus configuration can be difficult when themes, plugins, and client fields interact. This skill provides focused guidance for organizing these settings safely and clearly.
actual_capabilities: Identifies the primary Docusaurus configuration file and its TypeScript role.
Explains how customFields can expose a client API URL.
Describes the classic preset, sidebars, and common documentation features.
Explains theme swizzling, custom CSS, and Layout wrappers.
Notes MDX support for interactive documentation components.
limitations: Does not create, modify, or validate Docusaurus project files.
Does not provide version-specific plugin compatibility guidance.
Does not configure authentication, deployment, or backend APIs.
Does not determine whether a configured API endpoint is publicly safe.

use_cases.title: Plan documentation settings
use_cases.description: Map configuration, sidebars, and presets before changing a documentation site.

use_cases.title: Expose a public API endpoint
use_cases.description: Understand how a non-sensitive API URL can be supplied through customFields.

use_cases.title: Customize site presentation
use_cases.description: Locate likely theme, CSS, and Layout extension points for a Docusaurus site.

prompt_templates.title: Find configuration files
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me where Docusaurus configuration, sidebars, and custom CSS usually live.

prompt_templates.title: Explain custom fields
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how to expose a public API URL through Docusaurus customFields.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a theme change
prompt_templates.prompt: List the Docusaurus theme swizzling and CSS areas to review before changing navigation.

prompt_templates.title: Review configuration boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Docusaurus configuration plan and identify values that must not be exposed to the client.

output_examples.input: Where should I configure the documentation sidebar?
output: Keep the navigation structure separate from page content.

output_examples.input: Can I store an API token in customFields?
output: No. customFields are exposed to the client.
Store only public configuration such as a non-sensitive API URL.

output_examples.input: How can I customize standalone pages?
output: Review the Layout wrapper for standalone React pages.
Use custom CSS for site-wide visual overrides.

best_practices: Keep secrets out of customFields because client builds expose them.
Use environment variables for public endpoint configuration and document defaults.
Review plugin and theme changes in a local build before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not place API keys, tokens, or private URLs in customFields.
Do not edit swizzled theme files without tracking upstream changes.
Do not mix sidebar navigation rules with page-specific content.

faq.question: What does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It describes Docusaurus configuration, plugins, custom fields, themes, CSS, and MDX.

faq.question: Where is the main configuration file?
faq.answer: The skill references textbook/docusaurus.config.ts as the main TypeScript configuration file.

faq.question: Are customFields private?
faq.answer: No. Docusaurus exposes customFields to the client, so they must not contain secrets.

faq.question: What is the classic preset?
faq.answer: It is the standard Docusaurus preset for documentation, blogs, and pages.

faq.question: Can this skill modify my project?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance only and does not modify project files.

faq.question: Does this skill configure authentication?
faq.answer: No. It mentions an AuthBar location but does not implement authentication.
